name: ThriveWoo POS tax engine shared vectors
notes: Phase P2.1. Identical copies live in buskit-web/test/pos/fixtures/tax_vectors.json and buskit-pos/test/fixtures/tax_vectors.json; both test suites pin the same SHA-256.

legacy: expected values were produced by running the unchanged buskit-web services/pos/posTax.js computeLine. jsOnly cases use inputs the Dart port does not accept (decimal quantities, non-numeric percent).
lines / invoices: expected values were produced by an independent rational-arithmetic oracle, not by either engine. They are illustrative calculations, not verified legal rules for any jurisdiction.

lines.description: INR inclusive 9+9 COMPONENT_FROM_GROSS: base absorbs the residue
INR inclusive 9+9 BASE_FIRST, residue -0.01 to BASE
INR inclusive 9+9 BASE_FIRST, residue to LARGEST_COMPONENT (tie: first)
INR inclusive three components BASE_FIRST: +0.01 residue allocated proportionally (largest remainder)
compound exclusive: ROUNDED vs UNROUNDED prior differ (rounded)
compound exclusive: ROUNDED vs UNROUNDED prior differ (unrounded)
compound inclusive COMPONENT_FROM_GROSS with ROUNDED_PRIOR is refused
compound inclusive BASE_FIRST ROUNDED_PRIOR residue to BASE
zero-rated with a non-zero rate is refused
HALF_EVEN at half with odd quotient (0.035 -> 0.04)
INR amount with more than 2 decimals is refused
amount given as a number (float) is refused
rate given as a number is refused
smallest amount: tax rounds to zero
BASE_FIRST DOWN: all component taxes zero, residue falls back to BASE

invoices.description: LINE level: 3 x 0.99 at 7.5% rounds each line (0.07 each)
INVOICE level: the same lines round once (0.22) and allocate by largest remainder
INVOICE level with a compound component is refused
INVOICE level inclusive BASE_FIRST is refused
mixed classes: exempt and zero-rated lines add no tax (LINE)
mixed classes at INVOICE level, equal rate strings grouped once
